{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: divide biomarker_final by 10
df['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df['biomarker_final'].copy()
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Verify correction
print(f'Batch A: {df[df["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final_corrected"].mean():.2f} ng/mL')
print(f'Batch B: {df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final_corrected"].mean():.2f} ng/mL')

# Check if correction was applied correctly
print(f'Batch B mean before correction: {df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Batch B mean after correction: {df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final_corrected"].mean():.2f}')"}}
